title: Exact-SKU physical-count observation freshness validation
request: Exactly { freshnessValidationInput: purported canonical FOOD-006Y result, referenceTime: explicit UTC-second string, maxObservationAgeSeconds: explicit nonnegative safe integer }. No database dependency.
eligibility: Only canonical FOOD-006Y validated. Canonical invalid/ineligible/stale/storage-failure return ineligible with upstreamOutcome. Strict root shape and plain canonical data are checked first; time policy is evaluated only for eligible upstream input.
canonicalization: Y has no exported pure result validator. Snapshot plain acyclic enumerable data; reject hooks/accessors/symbols/hidden fields. Reclassify retained W via canonical X; require converged and deep JSON value agreement. Rebuild stored N1 acquired envelope, validate nonnegative safe head/nonempty opaque bookmark/exact SKU, enforce Y equality or advanced-stale relation and deep-check all outer aliases. Never call Y orchestration or N1. Canonical deep-value replay is not cryptographic proof that an asserted historical read occurred.
physicalObservation: Extract upstream.convergence.correctionInclusionVerification.postCorrectionVerification.bookkeepingReconciliation.countObservation; validate via canonical FOOD-006Q. Preserve original observation with observedAt/count/SKU/attribution/sourceReference and full detached Y provenance.
referenceTime: Caller-supplied canonical UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ, year 0001..9999, Gregorian calendar, seconds only. Reuse Q validation with an internal timestamp-substituted copy solely to validate the reference field; emit only the original observation. No duplicated calendar parser or new physical observation is asserted.
ageArithmetic: Date.parse on already canonical UTC-second instants only; subtract milliseconds then divide exactly by 1000. Entire year 0001..9999 span is 315537897599 seconds, within safe integer range. Reject nonfinite/noninteger/negative computed age. No rounding or clock read.
maxObservationAgeSeconds: Explicit nonnegative safe integer up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; zero is valid and means same instant only, not unlimited. No default threshold or SLA.
boundary: Inclusive: observationAgeSeconds <= maxObservationAgeSeconds is fresh; greater is stale.
futureObservation: observedAt > referenceTime returns invalid, never clamps age to zero; caller temporal ordering error, not a storage failure.

outcomes.invalid: Malformed/noncanonical request or upstream provenance; invalid reference/allowance; future observation.
outcomes.ineligible: Canonical Y outcome other than validated; no time-policy certification.
outcomes.fresh: At the supplied reference time, the retained canonical exact-SKU physical count observation was no older than the explicitly allowed observation age.
outcomes.stale: At the supplied reference time, the observation exceeded the allowance; not a claim that the historical count was wrong.

result: fresh/stale retain sku, referenceTime, maxObservationAgeSeconds, observationAgeSeconds, physicalCountObservation and upstreamEvidenceFreshnessValidation. observedAt/count are retained only in the observation, not duplicated as new authoritative fields. Output recursively frozen/detached and deterministic.
timeAuthority: Reference time and age policy are explicit assertions, not authenticated by this pure function. Reference time is not bound to Y primary-query time. No later head is acquired and no absence of evidence after that historical query is asserted.
recordedVsPhysicalFreshness: Y validated and Z stale can coexist. Z evaluates the asserted observation timestamp against policy, not physical-world truth or continuing recorded evidence currentness.
negativeBalances: Canonical X converged/Y validated SKU total equals a nonnegative count, so negative aggregate is impossible under eligibility. Nested batch/original signed evidence may be negative; preserve without clamping or treating as physical negative stock.
invariants: Keep existing product/recipe/package/SKU/price/availability/order/payment/customer/identity distinctions. Fresh observation does not guarantee an unchanged physical world after observation. No capacity number or operational authority is derived.
